ruleDefinitions.name: Microsoft Office Protected View Disabled
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects changes to Microsoft Office protected view registry keys with which the attacker disables this feature. Note: Unmapped fields: Details

sequences.query: (registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\SOFTWARE\\\\Microsoft\\\\Office\\\\.*") AND registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Security\\\\ProtectedView\\\\.*")) AND ((Details = "DWORD\ \(0x00000001\)" AND (registry_path = RGX("\\\\DisableAttachementsInPV$") OR registry_path = RGX("\\\\DisableInternetFilesInPV$") OR registry_path = RGX("\\\\DisableIntranetCheck$") OR registry_path = RGX("\\\\DisableUnsafeLocationsInPV$"))) OR (Details = "DWORD\ \(0x00000000\)" AND (registry_path = RGX("\\\\enabledatabasefileprotectedview$") OR registry_path = RGX("\\\\enableforeigntextfileprotectedview$"))))
